meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,把 oh-my-opencode 发布到 npm,并逐项验证发布产物(含 Discord 公告与各 npm 包版本)。发布期间不跑发布前复审,也不重新审查已合并代码。
howto.when: 当你提出发布/发版请求,并给出 patch、minor、major 或明确语义化版本号时触发;若没给版本选择,它会立刻停下并询问。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发工作流并验证 npm 产物
新功能、向后兼容的版本
用明确语义化版本号发布

howto.what_en: Triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow to ship oh-my-opencode to npm and verifies the release artifacts, including the Discord announcement and each npm package version. It runs no pre-publish review and does not re-review merged code.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to publish or release and give a selector: patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver. With no selector it stops and asks for one.

say_en.note: Triggers the workflow and verifies npm
